changelog: 🚀 JIN v2.2.1: 100% Complete Mobile-Harness Autonomous Integration, Dedicated JIN Fusion Screen, Responsive TopBar & Multi-Agent Swarm.
📱 Responsive TopBar Fix: Solved title and 'Select Project' picker vertical text squeezing on all mobile screen sizes with a dedicated horizontal utility sub-bar.

⚡ Brand New JIN Fusion Interface: Dedicated Cyberpunk Obsidian & Electric Amber layout uniting conversational AI with a live autonomous coding console, real-time reasoning stream, and instant Android project actions.

🤖 Full 100% Mobile-Harness Engine: Powered by JinAutonomousEngine driving Antigravity CLI, DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, and built-in resilient autonomous loop with real file reads/writes, bash execution, and tests.

📦 Real Toolchain & Coding Agent Downloader: Full on-device installation for Core Ubuntu 20.04 (Node.js/npm/Git), Claude Code, DeepSeek Harness, Antigravity CLI, Python, Android SDK 36/Gradle, C/C++ (gcc/g++/cmake), and PHP/Composer with live byte progress and offline APK auto-detection.
⚡ Multi-Agent Swarm Orchestrator: New prompt box toggle (⚡ Swarm: ON) dispatching tasks across all active agent networks concurrently.
🔄 Unlimited Concurrent Background Chat Sessions: Multi-chat streaming remains fully active in the background without getting aborted or dropped when switching chats.
📝 Real Checkpoints & Syntax-Colored Diffs: Full line-by-line diff inspector with additions (+), deletions (-), per-file Revert/Accept, and 1-tap Accept All / Revert All baseline controls.

🔨 Working Android Build & 1-Click Installer: Compiles Android projects inside Termux/PRoot using AAPT2/Gradle wrapper, diagnoses compiler issues, and installs generated debug APK directly to phone via AndroidAppInstaller.
🔄 3 Distinct Dedicated UI Modes: Seamless 1-tap switcher between JIN Classic (Gemini Deep Blue), JIN Fusion (Cyberpunk Amber), and Harness Studio (Claude Terracotta) in headers and Floating Switcher.
🛡️ 100% Attribution: Fully developed and authored by Samir Ahmmed (https://github.com/samir-ahmmed-tech/jin).
